entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

n lani b’ a la ko ele ye ne dan n tiga ala, janko n’ ka se k’ i lɔn, k’ i bato. n’ be n’ ka sebaliya kasi, ka i ka kotigiya tando. n be hami ni n ka fantanya ye, ka i ka fɛɛ ntigiya jamu. ala wɛ rɛ te yen n’ e ala kelen tɛ, min bi se ka mɔgɔ tanga koo jugu ma min kelen y’ a yɛrɛ.
